ram_vram_rules.note: Typical adequate floor: system RAM ≥ total VRAM
Comfortable headroom when the CPU stages large training batches
Certified multi-GPU server BOM guidance — not a home/lab workstation floor

ram_vram_footnote: RAM:VRAM rules move with the source and the job: inference and light fine-tune often sit near 1:1; CPU-side dataloading and offload push higher; certified-server guides still list 2× as a multi-GPU BOM minimum. Treat ratios as workload guidance, not one universal law.
